nom: CHANEL N°1 DE CHANEL SMOOTHING SERUM Smooths – Boosts Radiance – Refines Pores

avis.texte: Was super tacky and sat on top of my face- definitely tightened my skin, but it just sat on top of my skin- I have used serums a sixth of the cost of this one that are better. Way overpriced IMO.

avis.titre: My skin looks glowy and feels soft
avis.texte: I received a little sample in my order of the serum and creme. Wow. I have combo skin leaning on the dry side and my skin is practically glowing. It has a slight flower smell but it doesnt bother me. It smells expensive. It felt like a pleasure to put on. I'm actually considering dropping money for a full size, and this is spendy. My max for serums sits around $60 usually, but i may make an exception.
I received a sample of this snd i see a difference in my skin already! It makes you look fresh snd young:)

i have super senstive skin and tend to get redness all over, when u tell you this has made my skin feel n look 6 years younger and healthier!!! i was iffy at first because id the price but the results are worth it and thats just me using it less than a week! cant wait to see what my skin looks like in a month with daily use

To me, the tell that a skin care product is not high end is if its scented. A true quality skin care product doesnt need to be scented (fragrance can be irritating especially to the face) as the quality of the product should be enough without fragrance. If it was in an unmarked bottle I would think it was a cheap, chemically product.

I got samples of this at my local Ulta. After one small tube, my complexion had drastically improved. I have used this for about a month now and I haven't worn foundation in over 2 weeks. My pores are smaller, my redness is mostly gone. This serum is absolutely amazing!

This product makes some pretty bold claims. I will say it felt nice and was cosmetically elegant to apply onto the skin. The smell and texture of the product was very nice. HOWEVER, there were no noticable inprovements of my skin, even minor ones. At this price point, I was expecting to see at least a mild improvement based on the product claims. If you are looking to introduce this as a skin care regime, dont. There are other more effective products on the market. However if you want the ritual of applying an expensive product on your skin for the placebo effect, and enjoyment factor or "treating yourself" then this product may be for you. I, however will not be repurchasing and I will not be recommending it to anyone.

I am certain my skin issues are due to this product. I use Chanel skin care products with no issues, but my cheeks started with red bumps and a rash a few days after using this serum. Prior to that I had no issues. It's a shame.

I got this as a deluxe sample and was blown away at how fast it made a difference in my skin! It has reduced my pore size, evened out my skin tone, smoothed texture, and gave me a gorgeous glow! I am RUINED for life because this is my new go to serum!

Serum is hydrating and calming on my oily skin. Keeps my pores and texture smoothed out. Seeing lactic acid on the ingredient list made it click in my head on why this serum has such a smoothing effect. My favorite serum day and night.

Luckily I just had a few sample packs and didn't actually purchase this product. It immediately started ro burn my face and turn it red within seconds of applying it. If you have sensitive skin, I'd steer clear of this product.

Used a small amount consistently with other chanel face creams. After about a week I got the worst itchy, bumpy, RED rash on my cheeks. My skin dried out so much I had to use Neutrogena Hydro Boost day and night to help my skin normalize!

avis.titre: N��1 DE CHANEL Revitalizing Serum is totally awesome
avis.texte: I love the products line 1 DE CHANEL Revitalizing Serum. My face is clearing up rather nicely.

I received this product in a trial size as a gift for another purchase and it is worth its weight in gold! I had a smoother softer face after 1 application. I have now been ruined for every other serum I can afford. It's Boujee Chanel serums from here on out! I'm hooked!
I DO like this product and am excited about the effects it will have on curtailing my wrinkle development as I "mature".
I was given samples, and I died and went to heaven. After seeing the cost, I decided to continue with the samples. 2 weeks of use, and I'm sold! Bought the cream and serum! This is a must have!

Used for 4 weeks. Noticed my eye bags gradually looked even more pronounced in the mornings. And red streak in the bottom of of the eye bags on both sides. Stopped it for a few weeks, streaks vanished. Started it for a few days just to be sure not a coincidence, and bags got worse and streaks returned. Will try to return it. Very costly if I can't.

avis.titre: I would buy this product over and over
avis.texte: It's my first time using a skin serum and I love it, lasts me about 6 months and I've been using it night and day. Doesn't leave me feeling sticky even while having oily skin
I have psoriasis so I have sensitive skin usually some products burn your stuff did not burn saw anything the stuff is good
I love this channel product! My makeup looks so smooth and flawless. Worth the price!
I did not notice any difference in my skin after finishing the entire bottle. For the price this just isn't worth it.
By far the best serum. I tried the sample for a couple of weeks and I loved it so much I purchased the bottle. Worth the money!
So soft and fabulous fragrance! I've only used for 3 days as of today. But so far I love it!
This serum is so hydrating and beautiful. Perfection in a bottle. Worth the money for me.

This has made my skin so smooth! The video shows you can even put it on your lashes. It's safe to use around your eyes. It's very expensive but it's so worth it. I'm on my second bottle. I highly recommend this serum

If you have dry skin don't buy this product. My skin is on the drier side and this made it worse. Itching and it looked really dry under make up. I was excited to try it because the moisturizer in the N1 line Is quite nice. Very disappointed. Thank goodness I can return it.
fantastic results, love texture of this face serum, not meant for around eyes, use along with their eye cream for best results

For the first two weeks I was in love. It made the skin around my eyes look so much better. It smells amazing and the pancake is super luxe, but after I got atopic dermatitis under my eyes and got huge cystic acne around my chin. Sadly, I could only get store credit and I really don't buy the brands Ulta carry's. Disappointed. I really think this was gimmicky.
The ingredients are very cheap definitely not worth the price the most i would pay is 20$

I can't believe how my skin is reacting to this. It is so smooth and glowing! Although I get monthly facials and dermaplaning, my skin felt dry and drab. I since have added the lotion, creme, and eye cream from the line. I have a lot of higher and midline in cost skin supplies but this is a great investment

I love the experience of using the product, it smells divine and applies so nicely. The packaging is unique and feels luxurious. However after a couple weeks of using my skin is drier than imaginable, I'm flaking which rarely happens. Overall I'm disappointed that such an expensive product was such a spectacular flop.

avis.titre: I would use this product again
avis.texte: I love this product and how it makes my skin feel after applying it

When using this product properly, with the Revitalizing Cream, the results are quite noticeable. My skin is dry (with oily areas) and I typically use products from La Mer or Tatcha depending on the season. This serum is light, cooling and absorbs into the skin quickly. After a few weeks of use, I noticed a reduction in pore size in certain areas of my face, which I'm sure will continue to minimize with use. Following the serum with the cream is ideal, as the cream is light in texture and feels heavenly on dry skin. To those saying that this is just "green tea", I recommend they check the ingredient list and do more research.
I've been using everyday before my makeup and my skin is feeling and looking amazing all day and even after cleaning my skin is actually becoming smoother. I will be adding this permanently

I have fine lines around my mouth and this serum has plumped them in and I couldn't be happier. For the uninformed saying this is the same as green tea, it is not. This is the red camellia rose oil extract, not the camellia sinensis leaf. Both provide calming for redness but this provides anti-aging and pore minimization as well. It is worth every penny and is actually less expensive than some other prestige brands that don't perform as well.
So hydrating light and amazing ingredients will be repurchasing !

avis.titre: Compliment on my skin 3rd day after use
avis.texte: I use the serum than add my moisturizer on top. Already getting compliments on my skin first time ever. Over 50+ and I'll take it !

I'll be honest, I'm not crazy about all of Chanel's products, but this is amazing. I tried a little sample from an Ulta worker and rubbed it in my hand since I already had makeup on. She didn't bug me to buy it or anything. I appreciated that a lot! It left my hand silky smooth and the smell was nice and lingered the next 5 hours until I went home and showered. I did not buy it right away but a few days later I did end up getting it. I had buyers remorse immediately after purchasing because I did get the bigger bottle, but I told myself I deserved it and I've earned it. I don't usually spend this much on just one product but not only have I LOVED this serum, so has my mother, and granny.(which is saying a lot 😂) I even gave two little samples out of my bottle to two good friends because I was so excited about how wonderful it makes my skin look immediately after and I wanted them to see for themselves. Obviously two small samples isn't enough to tell if it works right off the bat, but it was enough for them to make sure it wouldn't break their skin out and see for themselves how soft it makes your skin. They loved it! Sure there are always dupes for expensive products, but ever since purchasing this, I haven't even touched my all time favorite peach and lily glass serum 😅 I wish I could afford to buy my mom and granny their own but maybe for Christmas they could run a little sale or something. I think that would be really cool and give others the opportunity to buy this pro

Beautiful serum. Goes on light and just dulls out my super oily skin. Texture gets a bit sticky which is perfect for moisturizer. I find myself using less blotters throughout the day! Could it be I finally found my holy grail for oily skin?!?!
Serum is highly absorbing and drys quick. Leaves skin feeling hydrating and fresh.
Glow and hydrates with texture ! I live this serum! Differently a daily for me!

I love this serum. it's spendy yes, BUT you don't need alot the dropper dispenses the perfect amount. It left my face feeling so smooth plumped and hydrated. I'm definitely adding it to my regular skin care routine. Your skin deserves LOVE!

I received a sample of this from Chanel and have been using it. First I love it's fragrance and very smooth texture of the serum. It has slight more gel texture then other serums I have used. Once applied it glides well over skin and my skin soaks it up pretty well. You will have a slight tackiness to it but goes away quickly. I do feel luxurious when I use it, and will stress the fragrance is strong. I feel like I am getting some skin care benefits from this serum. My skin feels smooth and toned but that could be from my other skincare. I usually use Clarins double serum, which is about the same price point and has been my tried and true. For some reason I don't think I could bring myself to buy a full bottle of the Chanel serum, probably because I feel like I am paying more for it's luxury name. I believe some things are worth buying from Chanel's price point, but I think you can pass on this.

avis.titre: You're paying for the name, not ingredients
avis.texte: Like other reviews have said, marketing green tea in this way is such a gimmick. You can have the same/better results with products that cost 1/5th of this.

avis.titre: Noticeable difference in tone and glow
avis.texte: Yes, this is a luxury brand so it is more expensive. You can probably get something that works just as good for your skin at a much lower price. That being said, I have used many moderate to high-end products and this is one of the best. I wrestle with large pores on a daily basis and this is the first serum I've used that I didn't have to follow up with a pore primer. in fact, my skin had a very gentle glow so I didn't even have to use foundation, just my tinted SPF. My new daily product.

i tried this serum, it is okay. not bad, but you can find a good product for a better price. camellia is another form of green tea, so many skin care products with green tea exist. you're essentially paying for the brand. mediocre ingredients for a hefty price tag = not okay.
I love this plumping smoothing serum! I also the scent of the Camilla flower and texture of this product. Will repurchase.

This is an interesting product. It's less. Serum-y and more thick water texture.. It absorbs super quickly, leave no oily or heavy feeling. Which makes My moisturizer absorbed easier as well. Skin definitely looks more luminous but not shiny or oily, lines softened out and my texture really feels smoothed. Pretty expensive... But I love that is helps w my acne as well as my anti aging concerns!
Do NOT waste money on this product. You can easily get a dupe of this product for a much lesser price. It's nothing out of the ordinary. You'll most likely pay just for the name brand! That's it
I love it! The consistent is nice, there is a slight fragrance but I love it!

Very light feeling. Smooths on easy. Smells lovely. (Camellia). Really tightened my pores. Can hardly believe how pore less my skin looks. Slight tightening feeling. I've only used a few times so far but really excited about

this serum is GORGEOUS! it makes the skin look so glowy but not too much glow. my skin looks so youthful after I use it. when using it with the N°1 Foundation, it's the perfect pair! makes your skin look like your skin but better. 100% recommend to anyone!
